li.p: Touch the rear window defroster icon. The indicator lights up when the defroster is ON. It turns OFF after 20 minutes or when the vehicle is in OFF position.
Touch the rear window defroster icon. The indicator lights up when the defroster is ON. It turns OFF after approximately 20 minutes or when the vehicle is in OFF position.
When the vehicle is turned OFF and then turned to POWER ON or DRIVE READY again during operation, the function will return to turn off.
When operating the rear windshield defogging function, the outside mirror defogging function also operates.
